transcript.text: bosch washer FD 9409 not draining. ive cleaned the filter already. what part do i need?

It depends on whether the drain pump is blocked or faulty. You may need a new drain pump if it has failed, but cleaning the filter was already done so check for blockages first. From what you have checked, this needs an appliance engineer to look at it: the next steps are beyond the checks that are safe to do yourself.
